title: Pithyx update channel v1
description: `channel.json` of a channel (D338): the newest update file of the channel. The box reads it once a day from its update source, checks `channel.json.sig` (the format of `index-signature.v1.schema.json`) over the exact bytes before it parses it, refuses a lower `sequence` than it saw before, and downloads the file only when the administrator installs it. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

sequence.description: Raised by one with every publish of the channel; a box refuses a lower one, so an old channel cannot be replayed.

url.description: Where the file is, relative to `channel.json` (for example `../beta-0.2.0/pithyx-0.2.0-amd64.pithyxupdate` next to the release `channel-beta`) or absolute with https.
